text:
maria: Heads-up — thinking about a 'fast filters' UX for Console: quick presets that adapt to the selected route and model, show estimated quota/cost impact, and let users preview telemetry sample.

kevin_p: love it. main asks: what rules decide which presets show? per-route recent-traffic? model sensitivity? region?

maria: start simple: top 3 filters based on recent signals: peak routes by 7d hits, highest latency percentiles, and model variants with rising error rate. show a small badge "est. cost +X%" computed from avg tokens.

jules_frontend: UX q: where is the cost badge placed? inline in pill or a hovercard? inline might clutter small screens.

maria: inline for desktop, hovercard on mobile. also allow "apply temporarily" vs "save as view" toggle — avoid accidental saves.

dinesh_api: backend considerations: we need an API to return preset candidates + cost delta + sampling preview. propose endpoint: GET /console/v1/presets?route_id=...&model=... -> returns list. payload sketch:
```
[
  {"id":"hot_routes_7d","label":"Top 7d routes","cost_delta":"+12%","sample":{"rows":5}},
  {"id":"high_latency","label":"High latency p95","cost_delta":"-3%","sample":{"rows":3}}
]
```

sara_data: telemetry caveat: previews must be derived from sampled telemetry to avoid heavy queries. include sample_rate used in preview and a link to full query.

kevin_p: also add quota warning: if applying preset increases projected units beyond team quota, show "may exceed quota" and CTA to request burst.

maria: agree. final open Q: should presets be per-user or workspace-scoped? my vote workspace-scoped with opt-out per-user.

jules_frontend: implementable. will prototype placeholder pill + hover. I'll mock the hovercard with sample rows and cost calc.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: prototype branch pushed to staging at 1768512360. Please test.

maria: thanks — tagging @dinesh_api and @jules_frontend for sync tomorrow 10:30am PT :calendar:.
